entries.title: Isolated encrypted originals and transaction-bound source gates
entries.summary: Implement bounded fictional text-original vault services, registerable API and explicit-control UI seam for existing B03-02. No shared app wiring or production/independent acceptance is claimed.
added: AES-GCM envelope-encrypted immutable exact UTF-8 originals with SHA-256, quarantine and explicit hash/revision-bound scanner lifecycle, cancellation/restart/idempotency without automatic retry.

Current-authority scope/object checks, separate privileged controls, retention/hold/guarded local-only ciphertext deletion, append-only locally verified audit chain and same-transaction require_source publication gate.
Bounded strict registerable FastAPI routes, scoped mountable UI and44 fictional service/ASGI/security tests.
changed: No shared router/store/navigation/manifests, Source Desk, existing alpha source or frozen canonical delivery register changed. Integrator must explicitly mount and inject current identity/session, key/scanner/deletion/provenance adapters.
verification: 44 focused vault tests pass; final full shell regression1400 passed in60.05s on functional commita228fa169a40b9014b930bf4aeac215960f751f8, Python compilation and all19 browser-module syntax checks passed; only a dependency TestClient deprecation warning remains.

Initial full run96 Node-PATH failures/1299 passes retained, corrected by using existing nvm Node24 on PATH. Later added post-unwrap expiry test exposed caller-row-factory dependency (targeted1fail43pass/full1fail1399pass); cursor-local Row handling and authority recheck fixed it, retaining regression without weakening tests.

Unmodified canonical delivery/emergence validators pass and changelog --check passes; changelog --check --base remains the explicit central-integration gate until canonical fragments are appended. Lane fragments are proposals, not a replacement status ledger.
limitations: Fictional local bounded UTF-8 text engineering only; not managed KMS, real malware detection, independent audit anchoring, storage-wide/legal erasure, backup/recovery or production tenant-isolation evidence.

No common-router/UI/navigation or Source Desk/projection wiring, native/browser/accessibility/operator/professional acceptance, real client data, paid/live inference or external send. B03-01 and all security/production gates remain open.
Delivery proposal may be applied centrally only with this lane's remote-head verification; no PR/main/release/deployment/pilot permission is implied.

discoveries: The vault's existing WRITE grant cannot safely imply scan, lawful-hold, retention, local-deletion or audit powers. A separate current transactional control callback is required and missing control denies.

Revocation, scan cancellation and hold/retention revision changes during scanning invalidate publication even when a scanner later reports clean. Interrupted scans must not automatically resume or repeat on command replay.

Deleting a local encrypted blob can preserve an immutable descriptor and audited tombstone while leaving derived text, WAL/filesystem remnants, backups, replicas and provider retention outside its scope. Without current dependency clearance the vault must deny deletion.

A source handle returned before projection publication can become stale, revoked or unavailable. The final source gate must run on the caller's same-database transaction and verify current scope, exact revision/hash, clean release and authenticated ciphertext, with audit rolled back alongside the mutation.

AES-GCM protects original bytes and authenticates their descriptor, but filenames, scope metadata and audit identifiers remain outside the content envelope. SQLite triggers/hash chains do not protect against an administrator rewriting or truncating the database and chain.

The isolated panel separates immutable original version from mutable vault revision and clears visible object data/disables mutations after an uncertain command outcome. Disposal/generation guards reject late responses; no automatic retry is performed. These are implemented safeguards, not browser or operator-value evidence.
risks: Separate-connection revocation races, stale scan/projection publication, privileged-control conflation, overclaimed deletion and metadata/audit/key custody.
architecture_implications: Source/collaboration final checks must share one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction; handles never authorize later transactions. Privileged controls and injected infrastructure stay distinct from kernel calculation and factual evidence.
emergence_review.roadmap_decision: existing_task B03-02 safeguards only: EM-153/154/155/156/158 adopted bounded implementation; EM-157 deferred production custody/security gate. No new required task, owner approval or broad status promotion.
